title: P1: defects no op can plant
description: Plants D01-D05, the lines of D08-D10, the BAD-BLOCK definition (D11), the paper texts of D14 and D16, D24-D30, D32, D33 and D34: plain lines, circles, polylines, a spline, a non-associative hatch, paper-space text, a per-dimension DIMLFAC override and a raster image have no op. Run after 21 (it uses the layers and styles 21 makes). The readback value lists each defect with ok or FAILED.

args.code:
(progn
 (vl-load-com)
 ((lambda ( / doc ms lays res try bylayer setprops mkline mkpline paperblock ptext)
   (setq doc (vla-get-ActiveDocument (vlax-get-acad-object))
         ms (vla-get-ModelSpace doc)
         lays (vla-get-Layouts doc)
         res nil)
   (defun try (tag fn / r)
     (setq r (vl-catch-all-apply fn nil))
     (setq res (cons (list tag (cond ((vl-catch-all-error-p r) (strcat "FAILED: " (vl-catch-all-error-message r)))
                                     (r "ok")
                                     (T "FAILED: returned nil"))) res)))
   (defun bylayer (o)
     (vla-put-Color o 256) (vla-put-Linetype o "ByLayer") (vla-put-Lineweight o -1) o)
   (defun setprops (o lay props)
     (vla-put-Layer o lay) (bylayer o)
     (foreach p props (vlax-put-property o (car p) (cadr p)))
     o)
   (defun mkline (lay p1 p2 props)
     (setprops (vla-AddLine ms (vlax-3d-point p1) (vlax-3d-point p2)) lay props))
   (defun mkpline (lay pts closed width / flat o)
     (foreach p pts (setq flat (append flat (list (car p) (cadr p)))))
     (setq o (vla-AddLightWeightPolyline ms (vlax-make-variant (vlax-safearray-fill (vlax-make-safearray vlax-vbDouble (cons 0 (1- (length flat)))) flat))))
     (vla-put-Closed o (if closed :vlax-true :vlax-false))
     (vla-put-ConstantWidth o width)
     (setprops o lay nil))
   (defun paperblock (name) (vla-get-Block (vla-Item lays name)))
   (defun ptext (layout str x y h style lay / o)
     (setq o (vla-AddText (paperblock layout) str (vlax-3d-point x y 0.0) h))
     (vla-put-StyleName o style)
     (vla-put-Layer o lay)
     (bylayer o))
   (try "D01" (function (lambda () (and (mkline "0" '(1000.0 0.0 0.0) '(1100.0 0.0 0.0) nil) (mkline "0" '(1000.0 20.0 0.0) '(1100.0 20.0 0.0) nil)))))
   (try "D02" (function (lambda () (setprops (vla-AddCircle ms (vlax-3d-point '(1200.0 0.0 0.0)) 10.0) "Defpoints" nil))))
   (try "D03" (function (lambda () (mkline "A-WALL" '(1000.0 40.0 0.0) '(1100.0 40.0 0.0) '(("Color" 1))))))
   (try "D04" (function (lambda () (mkline "A-WALL" '(1000.0 60.0 0.0) '(1100.0 60.0 0.0) '(("Linetype" "HIDDEN2"))))))
   (try "D05" (function (lambda () (mkline "A-WALL" '(1000.0 80.0 0.0) '(1100.0 80.0 0.0) '(("Lineweight" 50))))))
   (try "D08" (function (lambda () (mkline "WALLS-NEW" '(1000.0 150.0 0.0) '(1100.0 150.0 0.0) nil))))
   (try "D09" (function (lambda () (mkline "THICK" '(1000.0 170.0 0.0) '(1100.0 170.0 0.0) nil))))
   (try "D10" (function (lambda () (mkline "A-EQPM" '(1000.0 190.0 0.0) '(1100.0 190.0 0.0) nil))))
   (try "D11-block" (function (lambda () ((lambda ( / b) (setq b (vla-Add (vla-get-Blocks doc) (vlax-3d-point '(0.0 0.0 0.0)) "BAD-BLOCK")) (setprops (vla-AddLine b (vlax-3d-point '(0.0 0.0 0.0)) (vlax-3d-point '(10.0 0.0 0.0))) "A-WALL" '(("Color" 1))))))))
   (try "D14-text" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-101" "TITLE 2" 2.0 4.0 0.1875 "TITLES" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "D16-text" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-101" "OLD STYLE NOTE" 2.0 6.0 0.09375 "OLDTEXT" "A-ANNO-TEXT"))))
   (try "D24" (function (lambda () (and (mkline "A-WALL" '(1000.0 400.0 0.0) '(1100.0 400.0 0.0) nil) (mkline "A-WALL" '(1000.0 400.0 0.0) '(1100.0 400.0 0.0) nil) (mkline "A-WALL" '(1100.0 400.0 0.0) '(1000.0 400.0 0.0) nil)))))
   (try "D25" (function (lambda () ((lambda ( / pl h) (setq pl (vla-AddLightWeightPolyline ms (vlax-make-variant (vlax-safearray-fill (vlax-make-safearray vlax-vbDouble '(0 . 7)) '(1000.0 420.0 1100.0 420.0 1100.0 440.0 1000.0 440.0))))) (vla-put-Closed pl :vlax-true) (setq h (vla-AddHatch ms 1 "ANSI31" :vlax-false)) (vla-put-PatternScale h 48.0) (vla-AppendOuterLoop h (vlax-make-variant (vlax-safearray-fill (vlax-make-safearray vlax-vbObject '(0 . 0)) (list pl)))) (vla-Evaluate h) (vla-put-Layer h "A-WALL-PATT") (bylayer h) (vla-Delete pl) (= (vla-get-AssociativeHatch h) :vlax-false))))))
   (try "D26" (function (lambda () (mkline "A-WALL" '(1000.0 460.0 0.0) '(1100.0 460.0 10.0) nil))))
   (try "D27" (function (lambda () (mkpline "A-AREA" '((1000.0 480.0) (1100.0 480.0) (1100.0 520.0)) nil 0.0))))
   (try "D28" (function (lambda () (mkpline "A-WALL" '((1000.0 540.0) (1100.0 540.0)) nil 2.0))))
   (try "D29" (function (lambda () (mkline "A-WALL" '(1000.0 560.0 0.0) '(1100.0 560.5 0.0) nil))))
   (try "D30" (function (lambda () ((lambda ( / s) (setq s (vla-AddSpline ms (vlax-make-variant (vlax-safearray-fill (vlax-make-safearray vlax-vbDouble '(0 . 8)) '(1000.0 580.0 0.0 1050.0 600.0 0.0 1100.0 580.0 0.0))) (vlax-3d-point 1.0 0.4 0.0) (vlax-3d-point 1.0 -0.4 0.0))) (vla-put-Layer s "A-WALL") (bylayer s))))))
   (try "D32" (function (lambda () (ptext "A-101" "PROJECT X" 4.0 2.0 0.1875 "NOTES" "G-ANNO-TTLB"))))
   (try "D33" (function (lambda () ((lambda ( / old d) (setq old (vla-get-ActiveDimStyle doc)) (vla-put-ActiveDimStyle doc (vla-Item (vla-get-DimStyles doc) "ARCH-ANNO")) (setq d (vla-AddDimRotated ms (vlax-3d-point 1000.0 700.0 0.0) (vlax-3d-point 1100.0 700.0 0.0) (vlax-3d-point 1050.0 712.0 0.0) 0.0)) (vla-put-ActiveDimStyle doc old) (vla-put-Layer d "A-ANNO-DIMS") (bylayer d) (vla-put-LinearScaleFactor d 2.0) d)))))
   (try "D34" (function (lambda () ((lambda ( / img) (setq img (vla-AddRaster ms (strcat (getvar "DWGPREFIX") "img.png") (vlax-3d-point 1200.0 100.0 0.0) 1.0 0.0)) (vla-put-Layer img "A-ANNO-NOTE") (bylayer img) (vla-put-ImageWidth img 50.0) (vla-put-ImageHeight img 50.0) (setvar "IMAGEFRAME" 1))))))
   (reverse res))))
args.purpose: Plant AutoCAD test defects that no op can create (lines with property overrides, circle on Defpoints, block with a coloured line, paper text, duplicate, 3D and off-axis lines, polylines, spline, non-associative hatch, DIMLFAC override, raster image).
